name: Temps Self-Hosted PaaS
free_limit: Free open-source self-hosted PaaS with unlimited local projects, deployments and users; Git push deployments, managed service provisioning, analytics, session replay, error monitoring and uptime monitoring.
watch_out: The MIT/Apache-2.0 licensed self-hosted software is free, but servers, storage, networking, database resources and email-delivery infrastructure are not included. Temps Cloud and enterprise/premium features are separate paid offerings; do not confuse them with free self-hosting.
